about: Samantha Stevenson is an attorney at Hammerle Morris Law Firm, located in Lewisville, Texas, where she offers legal representation across a broad range of civil matters, with a focus on business law, litigation and estate-related issues. Her practice includes handling disputes involving contracts and agreements, business law litigation, probate and probate litigation, as well as estate planning, guardianship and real estate law. She also assists clients with entity formation and banking law matters, offering practical guidance tailored to both individuals and businesses.

Ms. Stevenson brings a strong foundation in both law and accounting to her practice, allowing her to approach complex financial and legal issues with precision and insight. As a Certified Public Accountant, she is well-positioned to advise clients on matters that intersect with financial analysis, business operations and regulatory compliance. Her analytical background supports her ability to navigate intricate legal disputes and transactional matters with careful attention to detail.

Before entering private practice, Ms. Stevenson gained valuable experience through judicial clerkships with the 11th Court of Appeals of Texas and the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas. These roles provided her with a comprehensive understanding of legal procedure, judicial reasoning and effective advocacy, which continue to inform her work on behalf of clients.

Ms. Stevenson earned her Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting and her Master’s in Professional Accounting from the University of Texas. She later received her Juris Doctor, graduating magna cum laude, from the Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law. She is admitted to practice in Texas and is a member of the State Bar of Texas.
